notes: China-only model; mi.com CN page is the only primary source. Spec text is served in the page's own JS bundle (cdn.cnbj1.fds.api.mi-img.com/mi.com-assets/shop/pro/js/product/xiaomi-mix-fold-3/specs.11e31cc0.js) referenced by https://www.mi.com/xiaomi-mix-fold-3/specs. TRANSLATIONS: 长度=length, 宽度=width, 折叠=folded, 展开=unfolded, 厚度=thickness, 重量=weight, 外屏=cover/outer screen, 内屏=inner screen, 类型=type, 分辨率=resolution, 显示帧率=display refresh rate, 柔性AMOLED=flexible AMOLED. TRAP (c) per-variant thickness/mass: Xiaomi gives 10.96 mm folded for Moon Shadow Black/Starry Gold at 259 g, and 10.86 mm folded for the Xiaomi Dragon Scale Fibre version at 255 g. Recorded values are the Moon Shadow Black / Starry Gold (glass) variant, which is also the LARGER folded thickness. Xiaomi publishes a single length (161.2 mm) that applies both folded and unfolded, so open.height repeats it. No hinge-side vs non-hinge-side thickness is published, so depth_at_hinge is null. INNER PANEL: Xiaomi states only 类型：Pol-less Plus (a polarizer-less flexible OLED construction) for the inner display and never writes OLED/AMOLED for it on this page, so displays[1].panel is left null rather than inferred; the cover screen is explicitly 柔性AMOLED. CREASE: mi.com never uses 水滴 (water-drop) or any crease-shape wording for the MIX Fold 3 (the hinge is branded 小米龙骨转轴, Xiaomi Dragon Bone hinge), so hinge.crease is null. free_stop is true on the strength of 悬停观影 (hover viewing) and 多角度悬停创作 (multi-angle hover creation) on the mi.com product page. MATERIALS: mi.com has no frame/back/cover-glass spec rows; the back finishes named on the product page (丝绒玻璃 velvet glass, 新一代皮纹玻璃 new-generation leather-grain glass, 小米龙鳞纤维 Dragon Scale Fibre) are recorded as the variant-dependent back, and frame and cover_glass are left null. Announce/release dates are not stated anywhere on mi.com, so both are null. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'book'; hinge.axis = 'long'.
